title: Document AI & OCR
tagline: Get text, tables, and fields out of scans and PDFs: image cleanup, classic OCR engines, handwriting recognition, layout-aware models, PDF-to-Markdown tools, and vision-language models that read pages directly.
prereqs: Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Computer Vision helps for the handwriting and layout steps. The last two steps run 3B-7B vision-language models, so use a GPU or Colab there.

steps.title: What OCR is
steps.why: How software goes from scanned pixels to recognized characters.

steps.title: Clean up images before OCR
steps.why: Binarize, denoise, deskew, and remove borders with OpenCV so OCR misreads less.

steps.title: Read text with pytesseract, EasyOCR, and keras-ocr
steps.why: Run three open OCR libraries on real photos and compare their results.

steps.title: Handwriting recognition with a CNN, LSTM, and CTC
steps.why: Train a CNN-LSTM with CTC loss to read handwritten words from IAM.

steps.title: Extract tables from PDFs
steps.why: Compare Python libraries for pulling tables out of PDFs, and where each fails.

steps.title: Layout-aware models with LayoutLM
steps.why: Feed word positions with the text so a model can label form fields.

steps.title: Parse documents with Docling
steps.why: Turn PDFs and office files into structured text and tables for LLM apps.

steps.title: Convert PDFs to Markdown with Marker
steps.why: Turn complex PDFs into Markdown that keeps headings and tables.

steps.title: Vision-language models as OCR: olmOCR
steps.why: A fine-tuned 7B vision-language model reads page images into clean text.

steps.title: DeepSeek-OCR and text as vision tokens
steps.why: Encode a page as a few vision tokens, then decode its text from them.

projects: Photograph 20 receipts, clean them with OpenCV, run two OCR engines, and report each one's character error rate against your own transcriptions.
Convert 10 PDFs with tables into Markdown using Docling and Marker, and write up where each one broke a table or the reading order.
Fine-tune LayoutLM on the FUNSD forms dataset to label questions and answers, and report per-label F1.
